highlights:
## Choose backup models

Choose up to three backup models in **Settings → Models**. If a request fails before the model starts answering, Nod can continue with the next backup. Nod uses only the backups you choose. **Stop** still ends the work. A connection that needs attention still asks you to reconnect.

## Choose the Windows install folder

You can choose where to install Nod on Windows again. Updates keep your chosen folder.

Setup avoids occupied private computer folders. Recovery keeps existing data when saved configuration is missing or cannot be checked. If Nod asks for recovery, select **Report bug** and review the report before sending it.

## Also in this release

- **Sign-in:** Nod checks that the required fields and buttons are present before it uses a saved login. Sign-in choices now work under layers that allow clicks through.
- **Replies:** A local connection that stops responding now produces an error instead of keeping requests waiting without a time limit.
